features.entry: Session header view-tab row in the shipped `web` profile; the tab labelled `mcp` that the plugin's browser half registers
features.input: Open the tokenized `dsh web` URL in Chromium, dismiss the first-run dialogs, choose a workspace in the directory picker, commit one composer turn, then read the tab row without selecting the tab
features.expect: An `mcp` tab exists immediately to the right of the Trajectory tab, in one non-overlapping row inside the viewport; selecting it renders the status page heading

features.entry: The `mcp` tab with no effective servers configured
features.input: Boot a profile whose composition list is empty and whose settings section is empty, open the `mcp` tab
features.expect: The page shows the heading `MCP 状态`, the `刷新` control, and the exact text `No MCP servers configured.` with no rows and no overflow of its own box

features.entry: The `刷新` button in the MCP status page header
features.input: Open the `mcp` tab and click `刷新`
features.expect: A new GET to the status route is issued and the view settles on the same state without errors

features.entry: The plugin entry's `servers` list (profile patch row `mcp-support`), documented in README "Composition config example"
features.input: Configure three composition servers (two stdio fixtures and one streamable-http fixture) and open the `mcp` tab
features.expect: All three render in configured order with the right transport, mounted state, no overlap, no clipped names, and the route payload matches the visible list

features.entry: A `transport: stdio` server entry (composition or settings)
features.input: Let the plugin mount the native bridge for a stdio fixture that logs its lifecycle to a marker file
features.expect: The fixture process starts and receives `initialize`, `notifications/initialized` and `tools/list`, proving the bridge spawned it and discovered tools

features.entry: A `transport: streamable-http` server entry with `url` and `headers`
features.input: Point the plugin at a harness-owned streamable-http MCP fixture and let it connect
features.expect: The HTTP fixture receives `initialize` and `tools/list` over HTTP and the row renders as mounted with transport `streamable-http`

features.entry: The per-row mounted indicator on the MCP status page
features.input: Render a status page containing a live server and a server whose mount rejected
features.expect: Each row reports `mounted` or `not mounted` consistently with the status route's `mounted` field

features.entry: The persisted `mcp-support` settings namespace in `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`, documented in README "Settings example"
features.input: Configure composition `[alpha, shared]` plus a settings section that redefines `shared` with another transport and appends `gamma`
features.expect: `shared` keeps its composition position but carries the settings transport, `gamma` is appended last, and the overridden composition server is never spawned

features.entry: Editing `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml` while dsh is running (the `applies: 'live'` settings registration)
features.input: Rewrite the settings section to add a server, refresh the view, then rewrite it to remove the server and refresh again
features.expect: The added server mounts a real child process and appears in the list; after removal its row disappears and the host payload contains only the composition server

features.entry: A server whose mount rejects (only possible with `failOnStartupError: true`)
features.input: Introduce a dead stdio command with `failOnStartupError: true` through a live settings write while a healthy server keeps running
features.expect: The failed row reads `not mounted` and carries the native bridge's error message, the healthy row stays mounted, the text wraps inside its row, and a refresh reproduces the same state

features.entry: The `failOnStartupError` field of a server entry (documented default `false`)
features.input: Boot the headless profile twice: once with a dead server at the default `false`, once with `true`
features.expect: With `false` the plugin row still activates and the healthy sibling mounts; with `true` the mount rejects and is reported as a mount error instead of silently retrying

features.entry: `GET /plugins/@royenheart/dsh-plugin-mcp-support/status`, the session-agnostic endpoint the browser half reads
features.input: Issue GET, HEAD, POST, PUT, DELETE and a longer sub-path from the browser context
features.expect: GET answers `200 {"ok":true,"servers":[…]}` with exactly `serverName`/`transport`/`mounted`, HEAD answers with no body, other methods answer `405 {"ok":false,"error":"method not allowed"}`, and the route matches exactly (sub-path 404)

features.entry: `dsh --profile headless <task>` with the plugin installed; the headless profile mounts no `webServer` service
features.input: Boot the headless profile with a stdio fixture configured and run a task
features.expect: The plugin row activates without waiting for `webServer` (no pending/did-not-activate warning), mounts the fixture, and the run reaches the model call instead of stalling

features.entry: The `stdio` half of the native `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` config union (`command`, `args`, `env`, `cwd`, `toolCallTimeoutMs`, `failOnStartupError`, `maxInstructionBytes`, `reconnect`)
features.input: Boot a profile with every documented stdio field set and let the fixture connect
features.expect: The config is accepted, the fixture receives the `env` marker and runs from the configured `cwd`, and tool discovery completes

features.entry: The `streamable-http` half of the native config union (`url`, `headers`, `toolCallTimeoutMs`, `failOnStartupError`, `maxInstructionBytes`, `reconnect`)
features.input: Configure HTTP entries in both the composition list (with `headers`) and the settings section (with `reconnect` disabled) and boot
features.expect: Both forms are accepted; the composition entry completes a real HTTP handshake and the settings entry renders with transport `streamable-http`

features.entry: Invalid `servers` entries in the composition config
features.input: Boot with a `serverName` that violates `[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}`, then with a duplicate `serverName` in the composition list
features.expect: The boot fails with the schemastery union error for the invalid name and with `duplicate serverName "…"` for the duplicate; neither is accepted silently

features.entry: A persisted `mcp-support` settings section that repeats a `serverName`
features.input: Boot with a `settings.yaml` whose `mcp-support.servers` list contains the same name twice
features.expect: The section is refused at the settings seam with the same duplicate-name message, so a list that can never reconcile is not stored or mounted

features.entry: The package's `dsh.bundle.patch` (`cordis.patch.yml`) declaring the `mcp-support` host row
features.input: Compose the headless profile with `--dump-config`
features.expect: The composed tree contains the `mcp-support` row pointing at `@royenheart/dsh-plugin-mcp-support` and carries the composition `servers` config from the profile patch

features.entry: `python3 install.py install|uninstall --profile <name> --home <dsh home>`, documented in README "Install into a profile"
features.input: Run uninstall twice and install twice against a cloned profile, then boot the freshly installed profile in Chromium
features.expect: Both commands are idempotent and report what they did, the link/dependency/bundle entries appear and disappear together, the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` is never modified, and the installed profile serves the `mcp` tab with the empty state

features.entry: `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`, `npm test`, documented in README "Develop"
features.input: Run all three scripts in the disposable package copy
features.expect: All three exit 0; the build produces `lib/index.js` (host) and `lib/client.js` (browser) and the node:test suite reports zero failures
